item_description: The highest mountain in the Andes and the highest summit outside Asia, located in Argentina near the Chilean border.
item_facts: Aconcagua is in Mendoza Province, Argentina.
Its summit is the highest point in both the Western and Southern Hemispheres.
Published elevation figures have varied as surveying methods improved.

item_description: A Himalayan mountain in Nepal, known as one of the world's most challenging high-altitude peaks to climb.
item_facts: Annapurna I is the 10th-highest mountain above sea level.
It was the first eight-thousand-meter peak to be successfully climbed.
The Annapurna massif includes several distinct summits.

item_description: A major Himalayan peak on the Nepal–Tibet border, rising above the Tibetan Plateau.
item_facts: Cho Oyu is the sixth-highest mountain above sea level.

item_description: The highest mountain in North America, rising from the Alaska Range in the interior of Alaska.
item_facts: Denali reaches 20,310 feet above sea level.
Its name comes from the Koyukon Athabascan language and means 'the tall one.'
Measured from base to summit, Denali rises higher than Mount Everest.

source_refs.title: Geology of Denali National Park and Preserve, U.S. Geological Survey

item_description: A high Himalayan massif in Nepal, with Dhaulagiri I as its tallest summit.
item_facts: Dhaulagiri I is the seventh-highest mountain above sea level.
The name Dhaulagiri is derived from Sanskrit words often rendered as 'white mountain.'
The massif lies west of the Kali Gandaki gorge.

item_description: The world's third-highest mountain above sea level, on the border between Nepal and India's Sikkim region.
item_facts: The mountain has five main peaks, reflected in the meaning 'Five Treasures of the Great Snow.'

item_description: A dormant volcano in the Caucasus and the highest peak in Europe under the commonly used continental boundary.
item_facts: Elbrus has two summits, with the western summit higher than the eastern one.
It is part of the Greater Caucasus range in Russia.
Whether Elbrus is counted as Europe's highest mountain depends on the Europe–Asia boundary convention.

item_description: The highest mountain above sea level, in the Himalayas on the Nepal–China border.
item_facts: Its summit elevation is officially recognized as 8,848.86 meters by Nepal and China.
The mountain is known as Sagarmatha in Nepali and Chomolungma in Tibetan.
Its height is measured from sea level; other definitions of 'tallest' can produce different comparisons.

item_facts: Mount Vinson is the highest summit of the Vinson Massif.
